items.brief: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
items.why: Highlights risk of fragmented tokenized securities platforms unable to settle with each other.

items.brief: Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
items.why: Signals regulatory urgency as EU blockchain settlement system handles a digital bond deal.

items.brief: MoonPay applies for national trust bank charter to expand stablecoin services
items.why: Shows stablecoin firms seeking federal oversight for custody and stablecoin offerings.

items.brief: Ant International, DBS, Franklin Templeton automate tokenized deposit to MMF switching
items.why: Demonstrates automated settlement between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds.

items.brief: Tokenized stocks shrug off crypto selloff, cross $4B onchain value
items.why: Suggests tokenized equities demand can decouple from crypto market moves.

items.brief: OKX's Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test with tokenized shares
items.why: Tests whether tokenized pre-IPO shares can price against futures and offering price.

items.brief: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia's tokenized stock volume
items.why: Shows tokenized equities attracting notable DEX trading volume.

items.brief: Ant International launches protocol for tokenized deposit and MMF settlement
items.why: Enables real-time settlement between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds.

items.brief: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
items.why: Shows central bank using wholesale CBDC to settle tokenized bills natively.

items.brief: Singapore's MAS issues $77M in tokenized bills settled via CBDC
items.why: Demonstrates native tokenized issuance and wholesale CBDC settlement by a central bank.
